high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "finologyticker." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the text "2. INVEST FOR THE LONG RUN." at the top, suggesting it is the third out of five parts. The main content of the post is a visual representation of stock price movements and net profits for Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) over a period of time. The graph on the left shows the stock price with key points marked: 324 in July 2011 and 2480 in July 2021.
